entries.name: Warrior
entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Juggernaut or the Berserker.

p: Open to every account from the start.
At level 100 a Warrior ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the temple starts the quest.

rows: The Juggernaut, an unbreakable wall: taunts, damage reduction, a shield that blocks and reflects.
The Berserker, two-handed fury: cleaving blows and a rage that grows as your blood runs out.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of Iron for 3 min. It crushes those who stand their ground too long. Keep moving.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

entries.name: Ranger
entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Deadeye or the Beastmaster.

p: Open to every account from the start.
At level 100 a Ranger ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the temple starts the quest.

rows: The Deadeye, the single perfect shot: crossbows, marks and critical strikes.
The Beastmaster, never alone: beasts that fight beside you and arrows that splash.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of the Hunt for 3 min. Its hounds come in packs; a hunter who stands still becomes prey.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Mystic
entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Elementalist or the Illusionist.

p: Open to every account from the start.
At level 100 a Mystic ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the temple starts the quest.

rows: The Elementalist, master of ruin: fire, ice and energy woven into great storms.
The Illusionist, the hidden hand: strength for your allies, weakness for your foes, some healing.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of the Veil for 3 min. The ground under you will burn with runes. Read the marks and step aside.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

entries.name: Thief
entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Ninja or the Samurai.

p: Open to every account from the start.
At level 100 a Thief ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the temple starts the quest.

rows: The Ninja, two blades in the dark: very fast strikes and the shadow step.
The Samurai, one blade, one breath: slow heavy strikes, parries and counters.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of Shadows for 3 min. Shadows do not stay still, and neither may you.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Monk
entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Shadowfist or the Iron Sage. Unlockable.

p: Unlockable class: reach level 500 with any character of your account; or buy the Monk unlock in the store (Classes, 500 Chaos Coins). The unlock is for every character of the account.
At level 100 a Monk ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the temple starts the quest.

rows: The Shadowfist, the killing touch: pressure points, flurries and chi spent in one burst.
The Iron Sage, the mountain that guards: chi wards on allies, stuns, the Mantra of Stone.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of the Still Fist for 3 min. Stillness is the lesson it teaches the hard way: keep your feet moving.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Lich or the Bone Lord. Unlockable.

p: Unlockable class: reach level 500 with any character of your account; or buy the Necromancer unlock in the store (Classes, 500 Chaos Coins). The unlock is for every character of the account.
At level 100 a Necromancer ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the temple starts the quest.

rows: The Lich, the slow death: curses, life drain and corpses that burst.
The Bone Lord, master of the army: more skeletons, the Bone Golem, sacrifices.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of Bones for 3 min. It raises the dead around it. Break them before they bury you.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

entries.name: Templar
entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Inquisitor or the Sentinel. Unlockable.

p: Unlockable class: reach level 500 with any character of your account; or buy the Templar unlock in the store (Classes, 500 Chaos Coins). The unlock is for every character of the account.
At level 100 a Templar ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the temple starts the quest.

rows: The Inquisitor, the burning judgement: holy fire on every foe around you.
The Sentinel, the shield of the faithful: a stronger aura, taunts and Lay on Hands.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of Dawn for 3 min. Its light burns where it falls, and it grows fierce as it fades.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

p: Every class, from level 1, no mana. A 3 s channel, then a portal home and a return portal beside the temple; all rules, the cooldown and the portal styles are in data/scripts/chaos/townportal.lua. The XML cooldown is only a short guard: the real cooldown (60 s) starts when the portal opens.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

p: A quick strike at the target next to you that builds 2 chi. The Monk's builder. A Monk strike (fist power, or a staff's): Pressure Points and the Shadowfist focus crit apply.

entries.name: Bone Spear
entries.sub: "kah oss lanc", level 15, 40 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Hurl a spear of bone at the target (range 5). Physical damage; the creature right behind the target (seen from you) takes half of it. The Necromancer line's filler. (level / 5 + magic level x 1.6..2.6 + 20..40) (necro_config.lua boneSpear; the level scale was dropped with the class trees); the Lich's Soul Hoard adds to it.

Raise minions from the corpses around you (up to 4 sqm), or one from nothing for twice the mana. The Necromancer and the Bone Lord raise Risen Skeletons (Necromancer up to 2 per cast, Bone Lord up to 3), the Lich a single Lich Shade. A corpse is used only when it holds no loot and belongs to you, your party or nobody; it is consumed. Caps, health and the minions' hits: data/scripts/chaos/necro_config.lua (minions), managed by data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua.

entries.name: Radiant Smite
entries.sub: "kah sol dyr", level 20, 60 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: A hammer-blow of light on one target within 3 sqm. The Templar line's holy filler (cooldown 2 s). Holy damage from the melee weapon (best of sword, club and axe skill x the main-hand attack) and a little magic level (the line's level factor was dropped with the class trees). A judged target takes more of it.

entries.name: Rime Bloom
entries.sub: "drai hyr rhim", level 20, 120 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Ice burst around the caster, chills everything it hits.

Throw a shuriken at one target; physical damage from your sword or distance skill. The Thief's filler (range 5). A ranged weapon strike: the better of sword and distance skill x the throwing star in hand (or a default star), so it works with a blade in hand too. It crits out of Shadow Veil and carries Poison Blades.

entries.name: Shadow Mend
entries.sub: "saen umh", level 25, 2% max mana mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Heals you for your level + magic level x 10 + 4% of your maximum health, 30% more while Shadow Veil is up. Healing does not end the veil. The Thief line's self heal (Thief, Ninja, Samurai). Numbers: Chaos.classes.shadowMend, rule ChaosClasses.shadowMendRange (+-10%); measured in server/data/spells/README.md "Healing".

entries.name: Blightswarm
entries.sub: "drai vex kriv", level 25, 110 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Toxic cloud around the caster, poisons everything it hits.
Pings every monster within 12 sqm on the caster's floor (max 15 marked) and reports the nearest.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Sundering Palm
entries.sub: "kah gal dhun", level 30, 80 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: A heavy palm strike that spends all chi; the damage grows with the chi spent. Finisher: x (0.30 + 0.14 per chi) of the 5-chi formula (ChaosMonk.finisherScale). Needs at least 1 chi.

entries.name: Vow of Mending
entries.sub: "saen tor fidh", level 30, 150 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: The Templar's self heal. Restores 8% of the maximum health + level / 5 + magic level x 4 (ChaosTemplar.cfg.vowOfMending, ChaosTemplar.vowAmount).

entries.name: Witchfire Bolt
entries.sub: "kah pyr vesh", level 30, 70 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: Single target fire bolt that leaves the target burning.

entries.name: Dawnpiercer
entries.sub: "kah sol aurr", level 30, 60 mana, cooldown 3 s

p: Single target holy bolt, the paladin's filler. Scales with distance skill x weapon attack (the bow's own).
Three spinning strikes (0 / 0.4 / 0.8s) against everything adjacent. Uses weapon attack and skill.

Roll up to 3 sqm in the direction you face; for 2 s after it you dodge more (+25%). Stops at the first blocked tile. The dodge window is a timer condition (ChaosMonk.ids.subId.roll) that data/scripts/chaos/monk_combat.lua reads.
Dash up to 4 sqm in the facing direction (stops at the first blocked tile) plus 2.5s of speed.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

p: Breathe the chi in and heal; the heal grows with the chi spent. Finisher (needs 1 chi). Monk and Shadowfist: heal yourself for (level x 2 + fist x 6) x the finisher scale. Iron Sage (the line's healer): the most hurt party member within 5 sqm (yourself without a party, or when you are the most hurt) for fist x 33 x the finisher scale, and 60% more over 6 s (CONDITION_REGENERATION, sub id ChaosMonk.ids.subId.breath). The Flowing Mercy keystone (the passive tree, class_tree.lua) also heals the next most hurt for a share of it. Numbers: ChaosMonk.cfg.breath / sageBreath.

Throws a trap up to 4 sqm (onto your attack target, else straight ahead). It arms after 0.6 s; the first monster within 1 sqm sets it off: a burst hits up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm. At most 3 traps (the oldest goes); a trap lasts 20 s. Say an element after the words (drai snar "fire": fire, ice, energy, earth, death, holy, physical) to choose what it carries; it is remembered. Without one, a brand rune in the spell picks it. Rules and numbers: data/scripts/chaos/snares_core.lua, snares_config.lua; the scheduler: _snares.lua.

rows: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai

p: Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 20% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm move 15% faster. Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

p: Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 20% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm regain 1% of their maximum mana every second (not in a rift with Parched Veins). Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Withering Curse
entries.sub: "kah nyx maled", level 40, 120 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Curse the target (range 6) for 12 s: it takes 15% more damage from everyone and rots (death damage every second, 10 ticks). The Lich's curse amplifies by 25%, rots harder and also curses up to 2 more enemies within 2 sqm of the target. On a player the curse only rots (no amplify). The amplify is applied by data/scripts/chaos/necromancer_combat.lua (ChaosNecroCurse); numbers: necro_config.lua witheringCurse.

entries.name: Consecration
entries.sub: "drai sol haln", level 40, 200 mana, cooldown 20 s

p: Hallows the ground under the Templar for 6 seconds. Each second holy damage hits enemies within 2 sqm of the cast tile, and allies standing in it (party, own summons, the Templar) are healed a little. Pulse damage: weapon power and magic level like Radiant Smite, much smaller per pulse; allies get ChaosTemplar.cfg.consecration.allyHeal x a pulse. The zone stays where it was cast and ends when the Templar dies or logs out.

entries.name: Purifying Wellspring
entries.sub: "saen vas aquen", level 40, 160 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Heals the caster, party members and own summons within 3 sqm and removes harmful conditions.
Up to 3 decoys wearing the caster's outfit, they vanish after 10s. Needs the "Clone" monster (data/monster/lua/clones/clone.lua in the reference server).

Vanish for 4 seconds; monsters lose you and your first weapon hit out of it is a critical hit. Stealth (Chaos.classes.stealth): an invisibility condition with the class sub id. Every pulse, monsters around drop the player as a target and take it off their target lists, so they cannot pick it again; a monster that still targets it cannot attack it (data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua). Dealing damage or taking a hit ends it. Not aggressive: casting it does not end it. When it ends the monsters get the player back on their target lists.

entries.name: Whirling Heel
entries.sub: "drai spir dhun", level 50, 120 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: A spinning kick that spends all chi and hits everything next to you. Finisher, area 3x3 around the Monk (the engine's area rules: PvP, protection zones, summons). Damage x the finisher scale of the chi spent.

entries.name: Forked Storm
entries.sub: "kah zhul zarn", level 50, 200 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Hits the target, then jumps to up to 3 more monsters within 3 sqm (70% damage per jump).

The Illusionist heals the most hurt party member within 7 sqm (or the one named: saen spek "Name"), and a mirror image of the heal mends the next most hurt (the Illusionist included) for 25% of it. Without a hurt party member it heals the Illusionist. Numbers: ChaosHealing.cfg.mirrorMend (data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules_core.lua). Weaver's Grace and the PvP healing reduction apply through data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules.lua.

Throws a mine up to 4 sqm (onto your attack target, else straight ahead). It arms after 0.8 s and waits for Detonate Mines or its 8 s fuse; then a burst hits up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm for 1.15 times a trap's hit. At most 5 mines (the oldest goes). The element works as for Snare Trap (kah snar "ice"). Rules and numbers: data/scripts/chaos/snares_core.lua, snares_config.lua; the scheduler: _snares.lua.

rows: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai

p: Every armed mine you threw goes off, 0.1 s apart, oldest first. Rules: data/scripts/chaos/snares_core.lua (detonate); the scheduler: _snares.lua.

rows: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai

p: Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 35% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm deal 5% more damage (not on top of Inspiring Illusion: the stronger counts). Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Ironbark Hide
entries.sub: "tor ael skar", level 60, 140 mana, cooldown 25 s

p: +20% max health and steady regeneration for 20s.

entries.name: Skewering Line
entries.sub: "kah sag lanc", level 60, 150 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: A 7 sqm line of spears hitting everything in it. Scales with distance skill x weapon attack.

entries.name: Earthbreaker
entries.sub: "kah grund krak", level 60, 150 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Shockwave (5x5) that deals physical damage and staggers enemies (heavy slow for 3s).

entries.name: Banner Call
entries.sub: "tor vas vant", level 60, 250 mana, cooldown 35 s

p: Caster and party members within 5 sqm get +10% melee/distance/magic and speed for 12s.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Poison Blades
entries.sub: "vyr vex thyss", level 60, 150 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: For 20 seconds your weapon hits poison the target. Each weapon hit (and weapon strike of a spell) adds a share of its damage as earth damage over 4 seconds (Chaos.classes.poisonBlades; applied by data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua, which sees the buff as a condition with the class sub id).

Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 35% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm take 6% less damage (not on top of the Templar line's defence aura: the stronger counts). Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Briar Prison
entries.sub: "drai thral brin", level 70, 240 mana, cooldown 14 s

p: Thorns erupt around the target for 3 pulses, rooting enemies in a 3x3 for 5s.

entries.name: Umbral Stride
entries.sub: "ruan nyx umh", level 70, 120 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Teleport to the far side of the target (range 5) and stab it with death damage.
Mana shield for 15s plus mana regeneration while it lasts (the stock Ward of the Mind has no regen).

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Crimson Covenant
entries.sub: "tor nyx cruor", level 90, 50 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Sacrifice 15% of max health for mana and a short magic level boost.

entries.name: Pressure Points
entries.sub: "kah mynd dhun", level 100, 120 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: Strike a nerve of the target next to you: 1 chi, and a stack of Pressure Points on it. Each stack (max 5, 8 s, refreshed by every cast) makes the target take +5% from Monks' hits and strikes. The stacks are timer conditions on the target, one sub id per stack (ChaosMonk.ids.subId.pressure), which data/scripts/chaos/monk_combat.lua counts.

Spend all chi on a shield of chi around a party member (or yourself) that absorbs damage for 8 s. Finisher: absorbs (level x 2.5 + fist x 8) x the finisher scale. `tor qhal "Name"` shields that party member within 5 sqm; without a name it shields the party member within 5 sqm with the lowest health share (you when you have no party). The shield is a timer condition on the recipient (ChaosMonk.ids.subId.ward) and the amount left a storage on it (ChaosMonk.ids.storage.wardAmount); monk_combat.lua absorbs from it. A new ward replaces the old one.

entries.name: Soul Rot
entries.sub: "kah nyx putr", level 100, 220 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Rot the target's soul (range 6): heavy death damage every second for 6 s. If the target dies before the rot ends, the rest jumps to the nearest enemy within 3 sqm. A recast on the same target restarts it. Ticks: (level / 5 + magic level x 1.2..1.6 + 20..40) x 1.15 x the level scale, Soul Hoard included (necro_config.lua soulRot).

entries.name: Bone Golem
entries.sub: "vael gal oss", level 100, 500 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Raise the Bone Golem, a hulking construct of bone (one at a time, on top of your skeletons). It slams every enemy next to it and taunts the monsters around it. With the golem out, the cast calls it back to your side and heals half of its health. Health and slams scale with your level and magic level (necro_config.lua minions.golem, golemClass); its hits are dealt as you (data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua).

entries.name: Judgement
entries.sub: "kah sol vehm", level 100, 250 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: The Inquisitor brands one target (range 5) with a holy strike. For 8 seconds the target takes 20% more holy damage from every source, the party's included (ChaosTemplar.cfg.judgement; applied by data/scripts/chaos/templar_combat.lua, which sees the brand as a timer condition on the target).

entries.name: Blessed Earth
entries.sub: "drai vas sol hal", level 100, 350 mana, cooldown 24 s

p: Consecrates the caster's tile for 6s. Each second holy damage hits enemies within 2 sqm and allies (party, own summons, caster) standing in it are healed a little.

entries.name: Red Frenzy
entries.sub: "vyr ira cruor", level 100, 300 mana, cooldown 40 s

p: +30% melee skill, -30% shield skill for 12s. (Not the stock Bloodlust.)

Step through the shadows behind your target and stab it. Teleports to the free tile around the target farthest from where the Ninja stood (range 5) and strikes it. A melee weapon strike: the off-hand follows it when dual wielding, it crits out of Shadow Veil and carries Poison Blades.

For 3 seconds the next melee hit you take is parried and answered with a strike, every other hit you take is 30% smaller, and the monsters within 3 sqm turn on you (the Samurai is the line's duelist off-tank). The answer does 1.5x the parried hit (Chaos.classes.counter; done by data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua, which sees the stance as a condition with the class sub id).

entries.name: Skyfall Cleave
entries.sub: "drai skai hrun", level 100, 300 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Leap next to the target (range 5) and bring the two-handed weapon down on it: physical damage to everything in a 3x3 square around the target, from weapon attack and skill (the knight spells' formula style). The Berserker's leaping slam. Every hit gets Rage (data/scripts/chaos/berserker_combat.lua), and the slam staggers (30% slow, 2 s).

Call your companion (a war wolf; 2 from level 400). Companions already out are called back to your side and healed for half their health. The Beastmaster's companion: its health scales with your level, its bites with your level and distance skill, and it attacks your target (data/scripts/chaos/beastmaster.lua, numbers in Chaos.classes.companion).

entries.name: Rebuke
entries.sub: "vok sol kal", level 100, 150 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: The Sentinel calls every monster within 4 sqm to face it (taunt) and slows them 25% for 6 seconds (ChaosTemplar.cfg.rebuke). Only monsters that are not player summons; players are never touched.

entries.name: Shattered Psyche
entries.sub: "kah mynd frak", level 110, 200 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Death damage bolt, then a cursing damage-over-time and a short slow.

Your companions leap at the target (range 7) and maul it, each for 1.5 bites at once. The Beastmaster's command. A bite is physical damage dealt as you, from your level and distance skill (ChaosClasses.biteValues, Chaos.classes.companion); it needs a companion out (Wild Bond).

entries.name: Iron Palm
entries.sub: "kah brak dhun", level 120, 200 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Spend all chi on an iron-hard palm at the target next to you; it stuns a monster for 1-2.6 s and a player for 0.6-1 s. Finisher: damage x the finisher scale; a stunned monster stands still and cannot attack (monk_combat.lua cancels its attacks while the stun condition lasts). Stun 0.6 s + 0.4 s per chi; afterwards the monster cannot be stunned for 4 s. A monster with more than 50000 max health is only slowed by 50%. A player is stunned by monk_combat.lua when the strike's damage lands on it (ChaosMonk.cfg.stun.pvp: 0.5 s + 0.1 s per chi, 6 s immunity, half as long within 15 s of the last stun); the spell only tells it the chi spent.

entries.name: Lucid Reverie
entries.sub: "reth vas spek", level 120, 300 mana, cooldown 20 s

p: A shared waking dream. The Illusionist and every party member within 7 sqm are healed 5 times, every 2 seconds (a heal over time that follows them: a member farther than 10 sqm or on another floor misses the pulse). Numbers: ChaosHealing.cfg.lucidReverie (data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules_core.lua). Weaver's Grace and the PvP healing reduction apply to every pulse through data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules.lua. Stops if the Illusionist dies or logs out.

entries.name: Banner of Bones
entries.sub: "tor vas oss", level 120, 300 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: For 20 s your minions deal 30% more damage, take 25% less and regenerate 3% of their health every second. A timer condition on you (necro_config.lua subId.boneAura) that data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua reads.

entries.name: Purging Nova
entries.sub: "drai gal sol orr", level 120, 350 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Holy fire bursts from the Inquisitor (circle of 3 sqm). It heals the Inquisitor for 10% of the damage dealt, at most 5% of its maximum health per cast (ChaosTemplar.cfg.purgingNova). A normal area combat (the engine's PvP rules apply). The heal counts the formula average per creature hit.

entries.name: Moonfang Pack
entries.sub: "vael luth wyrd", level 120, 450 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Summons 2 wolves (3 from level 200) for 40s. Tries "Spirit Wolf", "Winter Wolf", "Wolf" in that order.

entries.name: Iron Bellow
entries.sub: "vok vas rhov", level 120, 200 mana, cooldown 20 s

p: Taunts every monster within 4 sqm and slows them 25% for 6s. The knight gains Iron Will for 8s: 25% less damage taken (data/scripts/chaos/spell_guard.lua) and +15% shielding.

entries.name: Iaijutsu
entries.sub: "kah gal kaen", level 120, 350 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Gather for a moment, then cut your target with one heavy draw strike. The Samurai charges for 0.8 s, then strikes the target if it is still within 2 sqm. A melee weapon strike: it rolls the Bushido Focus crit, crits out of Shadow Veil and carries Poison Blades.

entries.name: Bloodrage
entries.sub: "vyr sang khar", level 120, 200 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Pay 10% of your current health; for 12 s Rage gets +10% on top and every melee weapon hit also strikes up to 4 other enemies next to you for 40% of the hit. The Berserker's frenzy. The health it costs feeds Rage (the passive bonus grows as health drops). Applied by data/scripts/chaos/berserker_combat.lua, which sees the buff as a condition with the class sub id (Chaos.classes.subId.bloodrage, numbers in Chaos.classes.bloodrage).

entries.name: Aegis of Faith
entries.sub: "tor gal sol aeg", level 120, 150 mana, cooldown 25 s

p: The Sentinel raises its shield and its faith: for 5 seconds it takes 40% less damage (ChaosTemplar.cfg.aegis; applied by data/scripts/chaos/templar_combat.lua, which sees the timer condition). Needs a shield in hand.

entries.name: Life Siphon
entries.sub: "kah sang nyx", level 130, 260 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Drain the target's life (range 5): three death strikes half a second apart; you heal for half of the damage they deal. Strikes: (level / 5 + magic level x 1.1..1.6 + 20..40) x 1.15 x the level scale, Soul Hoard included (necro_config.lua lifeSiphon).

A cloud of smoke around you blinds monsters for 3 seconds; they lose their target and are slowed. 5x5 around the Ninja. Blinded monsters drop their target and cannot pick a player while it lasts (re-applied every pulse), and are slowed 30%. Bosses (more than 50000 health) only lose their target once.

entries.name: Lightward
entries.sub: "tor sol ghar", level 140, 300 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Cleanses harmful conditions and grants 8s of strong regeneration.

entries.name: Shadowfist Flurry
entries.sub: "kah gal umh dhun", level 150, 300 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: Spend all chi on a flurry of blows at the target next to you: 2 + 1 per chi spent. Finisher. One hit every 0.2 s while the target stays next to you; every hit is a Monk strike, so it crits in the focus window this finisher opens (2.5% per chi spent, x1.5) and counts the target's Pressure Points.

entries.name: Mantra of Stone
entries.sub: "tor vas qhal", level 150, 400 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Chant for 12 s; you and party members within 6 sqm take 8% less damage while they stay near, and every pulse (2 s) heals them for level x 1 + fist x 26 (the Iron Sage's party heal, ChaosMonk.cfg.mantra.heal). The aura pulses every 2 s: everyone in reach gets a 3 s timer condition (ChaosMonk.ids.subId.mantra) that data/scripts/chaos/monk_combat.lua reads on damage taken. Uses no chi. Stops when the Sage dies or logs out.

entries.name: Bone Offering
entries.sub: "drai sang oss", level 150, 250 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: The skeleton nearest to the target (range 7) bursts apart: physical damage to every enemy within 2 sqm of it, plus 15% of the skeleton's remaining health; you take 20% less damage for 6 s. The skeleton is gone (raise another one). Needs a skeleton; the Bone Golem is never offered. (level / 5 + magic level x 4.5..6.5 + 80..160) x the level scale (necro_config.lua boneOffering); the shield is a timer condition read by data/scripts/chaos/necromancer_combat.lua.

entries.name: Falling Pyre
entries.sub: "drai gal vas infr", level 150, 700 mana, cooldown 20 s

p: Marks the target's position, the meteor lands 1.2s later (fire, 5x5) and sets enemies ablaze.
8s of invisibility plus a speed boost.

For 30 seconds your critical chance grows while you take no damage. Every second without taking damage adds a stack (3 at once, 10 at most); each stack is +3% critical chance on weapon hits and weapon strikes (Iaijutsu), a critical hit does x1.5. A hit taken starts the stacks again from zero. (Chaos.classes.bushido; counted by data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua, which sees the buff as a condition with the class sub id.) Recasting refreshes the time and keeps the stacks.

entries.name: Zealotry
entries.sub: "vyr sol zel", level 150, 200 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: For 20 seconds every melee weapon hit fans the Inquisitor's zeal: +4% damage per stack on everything it deals, up to 10 stacks (+40%). The stacks fall away 3 seconds after the last hit (ChaosTemplar.cfg.zealotry; counted by data/scripts/chaos/templar_combat.lua, which sees the buff as a timer condition).

entries.name: Lay on Hands
entries.sub: "saen gal manh", level 150, 400 mana, cooldown 1 min

p: A great heal on one party member within 5 sqm: 35% of its maximum health + magic level x 10 (ChaosTemplar.cfg.layOnHands). Say a name to choose (saen gal manh "Name"); without one it goes to the party member (or the Sentinel) with the lowest health share. Long cooldown.

entries.name: Corpse Explosion
entries.sub: "drai kadh krak", level 160, 400 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Up to 3 corpses within 3 sqm of the target (range 7) burst; each burst hits every enemy within 1 sqm of it with death damage. Needs a usable corpse (no loot inside, yours, your party's or nobody's); without one the spell fails and costs nothing. The corpses are consumed. Each burst: (level / 5 + magic level x 2..3 + 40..80) x the level scale, Soul Hoard included (necro_config.lua corpseExplosion).

entries.name: Vaulting Cleave
entries.sub: "kah brak skai", level 170, 250 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: Jump next to the target (range 5) and strike it with weapon attack and skill.

entries.name: Verdant Sanctuary
entries.sub: "saen gal vas vert", level 180, 600 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: A healing zone on the caster's tile; 8 pulses (1/s) heal allies standing within 3 sqm.

entries.name: Shuriken Barrage
entries.sub: "drai vas shur", level 180, 400 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: A fan of shurikens at your target and up to 4 more monsters near it. One ranged weapon strike each (shuriken power as Shuriken Toss) within 3 sqm of the target. Other players are only hit when they are the spell's target.

entries.name: Final Verdict
entries.sub: "kah gal sol judh", level 200, 450 mana, cooldown 14 s

p: Heavy holy strike, +50% damage against targets below 25% health.

entries.name: Nightburst
entries.sub: "drai gal vas umh", level 210, 900 mana, cooldown 25 s

p: Shadows gather for 0.9s, then erupt in a 7x7 circle around the cast position.

entries.name: Frozen Crypt
entries.sub: "drai gal vas hyr krypt", level 220, 900 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Freezing zone on the target's position, 6 pulses over 5s, enemies inside are heavily slowed.

entries.name: Primordial Squall
entries.sub: "drai gal vas stoma", level 250, 1200 mana, cooldown 35 s

p: Three waves (earth, ice, earth) around the caster, the ice wave chills. Cast time 1.5 s (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back. Power x0.98 (was x0.85 before the cast time).

entries.name: Colossus Fall
entries.sub: "kah gal vas tyr", level 260, 650 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Two crushing blows (0 / 0.6s) in a 7x7 circle; enemies are slowed 70% for 4s. Cast time 1 s, a wind-up (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back. Damage x0.77 (was x0.7 before the cast time).

entries.name: Hail of Dawn
entries.sub: "drai gal vas sol volv", level 280, 800 mana, cooldown 24 s

p: 3 volleys of 4 holy arrows, every arrow strikes the target. Scales with distance skill x weapon attack. Cast time 1 s (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back; at the end the target must still be alive, attackable, within 7 sqm and in sight. Damage x1.1 since the cast time.

entries.name: Tear in the Weave
entries.sub: "drai zhul riv", level 280, 1300 mana, cooldown 40 s

p: Drags monsters within 5 sqm next to the caster (monsters over 20000 max health are not moved), then two arcane-death implosions at 0.6s and 1.2s.

entries.name: Doomtide
entries.sub: "drai zhul infr doma", level 300, 1500 mana, cooldown 45 s

p: Three waves (fire, energy, fire) rolling out from the caster over 6x6 area. Cast time 1.5 s (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back. Power x1.38 (was x1.2 before the cast time).

entries.name: The passive tree
entries.sub: Points, presets, resets and the Paragon track.

p: One point every 4 levels above level 8 (passive tree points from bosses come on top). Keystones change how you play; notables are strong named nodes on the paths. Every class sees the main tree, and the Thief, Monk, Necromancer and Templar lines also a class section.
Up to 6 presets. A full reset costs 250 gold x your level; a single node can be refunded too.
After level 1000: 1 Paragon point per level, spent on small capped stats.

entries.name: Aether Edge
entries.sub: Keystone. Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Monk and Templar lines: your weapon and fist hits add 6% of your current energy shield as energy damage. Your maximum health is 20% less.
Classes: Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.
Spells that hit 2 or more enemies: 35% chance to echo 0.6 s later on the same spots for 50% of their damage. Cooldown 3 s.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist.
Your aura: 4% less damage more and 1 sqm wider. Aegis of Faith also covers the party members under your aura, at half strength.
Classes: Sentinel.
Thief line: every weapon hit poisons the target as Poison Blades does, with or without the buff, and your poison deals +30% damage. Your evasion is halved.
Classes: Thief, Ninja, Samurai.
Your Bone Golem hits +60% harder and has +50% health.
Classes: Bone Lord.
With a shield: 15% chance to block a melee or ranged attack completely, and 30% of melee damage taken is reflected to the attacker.
Classes: Juggernaut.
With a shield: 15% chance to block a melee or ranged attack completely, and 30% of melee damage taken is reflected to the attacker.
Classes: Warrior.

A critical hit releases a burst on the other enemies within 1 sqm of its target for 60% of the hit, of your strongest tree element (energy if none), at most once every 0.8 s. Your non-critical hits deal 5% less.
Classes: every class.
Two-handed melee hits cleave: up to 3 other enemies next to you take 40% of the hit.
Classes: Berserker.
Two-handed melee hits cleave: up to 3 other enemies next to you take 40% of the hit.
Classes: Warrior.
Thief line: a monster that dies with your poison on it spreads it to 3 monsters within 2 sqm (5 ticks of its last tick). Spread poison spreads again, up to 4 deep. Your weapon hits deal 10% less.
Classes: Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

entries.name: Covenant of Vigils
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Mystic, Necromancer and Templar lines: your vigils reserve 30% less, reach 3 sqm farther and give your party members 20% more of every effect. Your own damage is 10% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.
Necromancer line: your minions deal +50% damage (Bone Lord: +20% damage) and have +50% health. Your own spells deal 25% less damage.
Classes: Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.
Crossbow and bolts: 15% chance for a Deadeye shot that deals double damage (+100%).
Classes: Deadeye.
Crossbow and bolts: 15% chance for a Deadeye shot that deals double damage (+100%).
Classes: Ranger.
Your Radiant Strikes have a 20% chance to judge their target (Judgement: +20% holy damage taken from everyone for 8 s).
Classes: Inquisitor.

entries.name: Effigy Covenant
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

p: Mystic and Necromancer lines: an attack spell hitting 2 or more enemies raises a Cinder Effigy on your tile (at most 2, for 12 s). Every 2 s it repeats the cast within 3 sqm of it for 22% of the cast's average hit. Your spells deal 35% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.
A spell hit primes the other elements: your next spell of a different element within 8 s deals +20% damage.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist.
Kindled Breath also heals the next most hurt party member for 40% of it (and its heal over time).
Classes: Iron Sage.
Soul Hoard: +40% spell damage per empty shade slot (instead of 25%), and +15% while your shade is out.
Classes: Lich.

entries.name: Hollow Vessel
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Mystic, Necromancer, Monk and Templar lines: your maximum health is 100. Your energy shield: the items' +50%, plus 50% of the health given up. It recharges 15% of its maximum a second faster and starts 1 s after a hit. No poison, no life drain can hurt you. Heals and leech fill only the 100.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.
Focus critical hits also give you a chi (at most one per second).
Classes: Shadowfist.
Bow and crossbow hits on the same target deal +4% more each, up to +20%. Another target (or 6 s without a hit) starts again.
Classes: Deadeye.
You take 8% less damage, 16% less while below 50% health.
Classes: Juggernaut.
Support (needs a party): other party members within 8 sqm of you deal +8% damage.
Classes: Illusionist.

entries.name: Iron Tithe
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Warrior, Monk and Templar lines: your vigils reserve maximum health instead of mana, at 60% of their share. They work on you alone, 50% stronger. No effect next to Hollow Vessel.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.
A dodge, or your first hit out of Shadow Veil, opens a 4 s window: your weapon hits and strikes deal +25% damage.
Classes: Ninja.

entries.name: Open Hand Creed
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Every line but the Monk's. With no weapon in your hands (a shield is fine) your fists hit with the Monk's fist attack (40 + level / 40, at most 60) and your best melee skill, +10% damage.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.
Heals you cast on others also plant regrowth: 10% of the heal again over 6 s (3 pulses). A new heal adds its share to what is left.
Classes: Iron Sage.
Your companions' bites and Feral Command deal +35% damage, and companions take 20% less.
Classes: Beastmaster.

Templar line: a melee or ranged hit you take is answered with a holy strike on the attacker for 40% of the damage + 4 x magic level (at most one every 0.5 s). Your defence aura's damage reduction is halved (for the party too).
Classes: Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Pyre Oath
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Warrior and Templar lines. Out of a protection zone and in a fight, enemies within 2 sqm take 4% of your maximum health as fire damage every second. You burn for 2.5% of your maximum health a second (never lethal; your fire absorbs count) and regenerate 2% of it a second. Your other damage is 25% less.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

Templar line: a Reliquary Warden follows you. Every 2 s it heals you and your party within 3 sqm (0.6% of maximum health + 2 x your magic level), the others deal +5% damage for 3 s, and enemies within 2 sqm take 0.6 x level + 3 x magic level as holy damage. Your damage is 10% less.
Classes: Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.
Bow and crossbow hits: 30% chance to ricochet to the nearest other enemy within 4 sqm for 65% of the hit, then once more for 65% of that (42%). Never the same target twice.
Classes: Beastmaster.
Bow and crossbow hits: 30% chance to ricochet to the nearest other enemy within 4 sqm for 65% of the hit, then once more for 65% of that (42%). Never the same target twice.
Classes: Ranger.
Every hit you deal leeches 5% of its damage as health, at most 6% of your maximum health in any second. Healing you receive is 30% less.
Classes: every class.
Monk line: a hit you take gives 1 chi (at most one every 2 s); while you hold 3 chi or more you take 10% less damage. You can no longer dodge.
Classes: Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage.
Support (needs a party): your hits mark the enemy for 6 s. Other party members deal +12% damage to a marked enemy and heal for 4% of it.
Classes: Illusionist.

entries.name: Sigil of Cinders
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Mystic and Templar lines: fire and holy spell hits ignite (15% of the hit over 4 s). A spell that hits one enemy brands it for 8 s: every second the sigil burns enemies within 1 sqm for 5% of that hit and jumps on when its bearer dies; ignited monsters spread the burn to 2 more when they die. Damage that is not fire or holy is 20% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Snarewright's Creed
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

p: Ranger and Thief lines: 2 more traps and 3 more mines may be out at once; they arm in 50% of the time and hit 25% harder. Your other hits (weapon, spells; not damage over time) are 15% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai.
Ranger line: bow and crossbow hits arc to 3 other enemies within 3 sqm for 40% of the hit as energy damage. The hit on its own target deals 10% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

A hit taken from a creature reflects 20% of what landed (and your Reflect Damage once more) as physical damage, at most 50% of your maximum health a hit. Players take a third (at most 5% of their health a hit), bosses half (at most 2 x your level a second). Your damage is 10% less.
Classes: every class.
Melee and ranged attackers take earth damage back: 30% of their hit + 2 x your magic level.
Classes: Sentinel.
Melee weapon hits heal you for 4% of the damage dealt, 8% while below 50% health.
Classes: Berserker.
Counter Stance parries every melee hit while it lasts (not only the first). Bushido Focus: a hit taken keeps half of the stacks.
Classes: Samurai.

entries.name: Winter's Lattice
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

p: Mystic and Necromancer lines: a monster that dies within 2 s of your ice hit shatters: enemies within 2 sqm take 6% of its maximum health as ice damage (at most 12 x your level). Kills shatter again. Your fire and energy damage is 30% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.
+1.0 Fire Absorption.
Classes: every class.
+1.0 Arcane Absorption.
Classes: every class.
+2.0 Arcane Damage.

entries.sub: Notable. Banner of Bones: your minions deal +45% damage (instead of 30%).

p: Banner of Bones: your minions deal +45% damage (instead of 30%).
Classes: Bone Lord.
+5.0 strength. +5.0 spirit. +5.0 wisdom. +10.0 vitality.

+3.0 Water Damage. +1.0 Water Absorption.

entries.sub: Notable. +1.0 Health Spells. +2.0 Life Leech Chance. +2.0 Life Leech Amount.

entries.sub: Notable. +1.0 Life Drain Damage. +1.0 Mana Drain Damage. +2.0 Life Drain Absorption. +2.0 Mana Drain Absorption.

Classes: every class.

entries.sub: Notable. +5.0 wisdom. +2.0 Critical Hit Chance. +3.0 Critical Hit Amount. +1.0 Increase all damage elements.

+6.0 Physical Damage. +4.0 Death Damage.
Classes: Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

entries.name: How items work
entries.sub: Rarity, item level, tiers, prefixes and suffixes in short.

p: Gear can carry a rarity: 15 of them, from Common to Transcendent. The rarity decides how many modifiers a new item gets and how many prefixes and suffixes it may carry.
Every item has an item level (1-150) from where it dropped. The item level decides which tiers its modifiers can roll: T1 (lowest) to T8 (highest).
Prefixes are damage and defence, suffixes utility, resistances and speed.
Orbs change items (Orbs tab); the crafting bench shows what each would do. Legendary powers roll only from Legendary.
Uniques have fixed stats and are never changed by orbs.

entries.name: Rarity
entries.sub: Modifier counts and limits per rarity.

p: New = modifiers on a new item; Sides = most prefixes (and suffixes); Max = what the Orb of Grafting fills up to; Binds = bound modifiers allowed; Quality = Whetstone cap; Sockets = most sockets by rarity.
Legendary powers: from Legendary, 1 per item.

entries.name: Tiers
entries.sub: T1-T8: the item level each tier needs and the odds.

p: A modifier rolls among the best 5 tiers its item level allows, weighted (higher tiers are rarer).

entries.name: Item level
entries.sub: Where the item level of a drop comes from.

p: A drop's item level follows the monster's level along the curve below (straight lines in between), then: Normal +0, Magic +2, Rare +4, Legendary +7, Boss +10; inside a rift +1 per rift tier (at most +15); an Omen arena +15 more; at most 150.
Fixed: world boss drops and rewards 145, store gear 60, the tutorial's gear 5.
Orbs keep the item level.

entries.name: Prefixes and suffixes
entries.sub: What a prefix and a suffix are.

p: Prefixes: damage and defence (skills, critical hits, weapon elements, block, dodge, reflect, thorns, penetration, ailments...).
Suffixes: utility, resistances and speed (absorbs, leech, attack and movement speed, life and mana on kill or hit, find, experience...).
A new item is rolled until its count or both sides are full; the Orb of Grafting only adds on a side that is open. An Orb of Ruin can give one extra slot on one side.

entries.name: Quality, binding and ruin
entries.sub: Whetstones, bound modifiers and the Orb of Ruin.

p: Each Whetstone adds 1% quality, up to 20% (30% from Divine). Every modifier value is multiplied by (100 + quality) / 100, rounded.
A bound modifier is left alone by Tempering, Unmaking, Excision, Reforging and Upheaval. Only an Orb of Erasure frees it (and wipes the item). An item with a bound modifier refuses the Orb of Fate.

The Orb of Ruin: 40% the item improves (60% of those one tier more on every unbound modifier, else an extra modifier above the side limit, once per item), 45% nothing, 15% it is ruined: no orb changes it any more.

entries.name: Pack combat
entries.sub: Monsters come in packs and die fast: kill groups, not one at a time.

p: Hunting monsters have much less health and come in bigger packs. Pull a group and kill it together: area spells and cleaves matter.

Experience and loot per kill are lower by the same share, so experience and gold per hour stay where they were. Kill counts (bounties, bestiary, tasks, achievements) need more kills by the same share.
Multikill: kills each within 3 s of the one before form a chain; the whole chain's experience gets 4 kills +10%, 6 kills +20%, 8 kills +30%, 9 kills +40%.
Bosses, rifts, the Ember Descent, the tower, invasions, arena, battleground and PvP are not changed.

Health, experience per kill, loot per kill and the monster's damage to you, in percent of the monster's own numbers. Monsters with a level of their own (late game, generated areas and dungeons) use the second set.
Classes with little area damage hit packs too: a direct hit on a hunting monster also deals a share of it to monsters within 1 sqm of it (never bosses, players or their summons).

entries.name: Base stat bonus
entries.sub: Attack, defence, armour and hit chance from the rarity.

p: An item with a rarity also gets a small bonus to its attack, defence, armour and hit chance, once: min + item level x (max - min + 1) / 100.
Absorb, suffix.
Absorbs a share of the arcane damage you take (shown on the item as "Arcane +N%").
Any gear.

entries.name: Rift Keys
entries.sub: Where keys come from and the orbs that work on them.

p: A key has a tier (1-15) and up to 3 modifiers. Modifiers on a drop: 1: 50%, 2: 35%, 3: 15%.
The modifiers make the rift harder and raise its rewards: quantity, rarity, experience, at most +80%/+75%/+60% (raised by tier IV and V modifiers).

rows: 30% + 10% per modifier (at most 60%) for a next key; 50% + 10% per modifier of those are one tier higher.
Rare 2%, legendary 6%: a key of the rift's tier.

Tier-1 key for a finished contract: hunt 25%, elite 50%, boss 100%.

entries.name: Rift Tiers and Rewards
entries.sub: Level to enter, monsters and the chest of each tier.

p: Tiers above 10 reuse the last window: +25 levels to enter and +15% health, damage and +10% rewards per tier.

Every rift is a new generated map: a cave system, an open waste, a ruined complex or a cave with ruined chambers, sometimes on two floors, with the guardian's arena in the far corner. Its size follows the key's tier: tiers 1-5 160 x 160 tiles, 12 minutes; tiers 6-10 200 x 200 tiles, 13 minutes; tiers 11-15 240 x 240 tiles, 15 minutes.
The guardian comes after 75% of the monsters; 3 shared lives + 1 per extra player; up to 5 players.

About 132 monsters solo at tier 1 up to 402 at tier 15 on a map of typical size (+25% per extra player; a bigger map holds more), in packs of 5-7 over the whole map; about 102-166 alive at once, the rest gather ahead of you as you advance. Most monsters are husks: experience only. Magic and better monsters always carry loot, so a run drops about what fewer, tougher packs did.

Each extra player: +100% monster health in total (more packs, tougher monsters), +100% guardian health, +10% damage taken; every finisher's chest +12.5% (at most +50%) and +5% kill loot (at most +20%).
Gold: 5000 x tier squared to the bank.
Orb of Upheaval: 0.5 + 0.085 per tier; Orb of Fate: 0 + 0.06 per tier.
Item rolls: 2 + 0.5 per tier from the rift monsters' loot, gear with a rarity; one currency roll and one unique roll.
Gems and spell supports too (Gems and Supports tabs). Gold, orbs and rolls x (1 + quantity bonus).

entries.name: Omens
entries.sub: Guardian arenas opened with Omen Keys.

p: Rifts of tier 6 or more give omen fragments; 60 fragments bind an Omen Key of a random kind. The key opens that guardian's arena (level 800, 12 minutes, the rift's lives). Omen keys have no modifiers.

3000 x your level in gold to the bank, 4 Orb of Upheaval, 2 Orb of Fate, 8 item rolls of the guardian's loot (x1.5 rarity), 2 unique rolls (x2 find), gems and supports as a tier 15 rift. Drops in the arena get +15 item level.

Nodes cost 1 (small), 2 (notable) and 3 (keystone) points; you hold at most 1 keystone. Refunding a node costs 250,000 gold or 1 Orb of Upheaval.

Kill 85% of the dungeon's monsters to unlock its boss, then kill the boss. A run lasts at most 15 min. Each finished difficulty unlocks the next one.
Speed and flawless challenges give points; solo and group rankings keep the best times.

entries.name: Nemesis
entries.sub: A monster that kills you may come back for you, by name.

p: When a regular monster kills a character of level 50 or more, there is a 25% chance it becomes that character's Nemesis. Bosses, summons, treasure goblins and the monsters of events and instances never do, and neither does a death with a player involved.
One Nemesis per character. After one ends, no new one for 6 h. Above 200 active Nemeses on the server the chance falls, down to none at 300.
It gets a name and an epithet that names you ("Varkh, Bane of Varek" for a character called Varek), a level 10-20% above the monster that killed you, a black skull, a blood-red glow and one trait.

While you hunt its kind, or monsters near its level, each kill has a 4% chance to call it: "You feel a familiar hatred watching you..." It appears a few tiles away, at most every 15 min, and fades after 5 minutes if you do not finish it.
It only appears for you, only hurts you and your party, and only you and your party can hurt it.

If it kills you again it grows: +10% level, a second trait and a new epithet (Twice-Slayer of Varek, Thrice-Slayer of Varek, Doom of Varek), up to 4 kills. A Nemesis you have not met for 14 days loses your trail.

rows: Reflects 15% of the damage it takes.

p: Slay it yourself: a trophy with its name engraved (once per Nemesis, cannot be sold or traded), the title Avenger of Self and a loot bonus in its corpse (at most once every 20 h).

A party member slays it: the Nemesis Hunter bounty of 10,000 gold plus 200 per level to their bank (at most once every 6 h, never for your own account or connection, never for a Nemesis younger than 10 minutes). After 3 of them, the title Nemesis Hunter.
Hardcore characters can have a Nemesis too; their reward is the trophy.

entries.name: The professions
entries.sub: Gather materials, sell them to a Material Broker, earn an experience bonus

p: Four gathering professions, each with its own level 1-100: Delving (ore veins), Wortcunning (herb patches), Flaying (corpses of beasts and reptiles) and Angling (fishing). They make no gear and no orbs: what you gather is sold to a Material Broker (one stands next to every temple).
Every profession level above 1 adds 0.0253% experience from monsters, all four together at most +10% (every profession at 100).

sections.h: Experience bonus with all four at a level

No one agrees on the night it happened. The sky split, and burning stones fell like slow rain for a season. Where they struck, the ground remembered fire: forests turned to ash, the dead stirred in their graves, and the first rifts opened like wounds that would not close.
The Cinders still lie where they fell. Some are cold. Some still beat.

Ninguém concorda sobre a noite em que aconteceu. O céu se partiu e pedras em chamas caíram como uma chuva lenta por uma estação inteira. Onde tocaram, a terra lembrou o fogo: florestas viraram cinza, os mortos se agitaram nos túmulos e as primeiras fendas se abriram como feridas que não fecham.
As Brasas ainda estão onde caíram. Algumas esfriaram. Outras ainda pulsam.

Every newcomer wakes on the same small island, among statues no one remembers carving. The Vigil says the island was the first place a Cinder did not burn. Whatever the truth, nothing there can kill you, and nothing there will follow you out.

Todo recém-chegado acorda na mesma pequena ilha, entre estátuas que ninguém lembra de ter esculpido. A Vigília diz que a ilha foi o primeiro lugar onde uma Brasa não queimou. Seja qual for a verdade, nada ali pode matar você, e nada dali o seguirá.

Archivist Maelis keeps a ledger of every name the fire gave back: bosses, rifts, Omens, the things in the deep. She pays for true accounts and burns the false ones. Her ink is mixed with ash, so that what is written cannot be unwritten.

A Arquivista Maelis mantém um registro de cada nome que o fogo devolveu: chefes, fendas, Presságios, as coisas das profundezas. Ela paga por relatos verdadeiros e queima os falsos. Sua tinta é misturada com cinza, para que o que foi escrito não possa ser apagado.

A rift is a place that fell with a Cinder and never finished landing. Step through with a key and you walk a piece of somewhere else, for as long as it holds. Each one has a guardian. Seal it, and the rift closes. Leave it open, and it remembers your face.

Uma fenda é um lugar que caiu com uma Brasa e nunca terminou de pousar. Atravesse com uma chave e você caminha por um pedaço de outro lugar, enquanto ele durar. Cada uma tem um guardião. Sele-a e a fenda se fecha. Deixe-a aberta e ela lembrará do seu rosto.

Floors of black glass over nothing at all. The Veiled Choir hears singing down there and answers it. What lives in the Abyssal Rift has too many eyes, and it has learned to close the ones you are looking at.
Pisos de vidro negro sobre o nada. O Coro Velado ouve um canto lá embaixo e responde. O que vive na Fenda Abissal tem olhos demais, e aprendeu a fechar aqueles para os quais você olha.

A hall of black marble that was never built by hands. Magma runs in its seams like veins. The Cinderforge Compact mines its walls between waves of the things that guard it, and calls the losses the price of good steel.

Um salão de mármore negro que nunca foi construído por mãos. O magma corre em suas juntas como veias. O Pacto da Forja de Brasa minera suas paredes entre as ondas de guardiões, e chama as perdas de preço do bom aço.

Graves that burned without being opened. The dead inside woke warm and angry. The Ashen Vigil rings its bells at every crypt that stirs, and sends wardens with oil and torches to finish what the fire started.

Túmulos que queimaram sem serem abertos. Os mortos lá dentro acordaram quentes e furiosos. A Vigília Cinzenta toca seus sinos em cada cripta que se agita e envia guardiões com óleo e tochas para terminar o que o fogo começou.

A gilded temple swallowed by fungus. Its priests prayed for the fire to pass them by, and something answered with rot instead. The Thornbound Circle cuts the blight back every season. Every season it grows faster.

Um templo dourado engolido por fungos. Seus sacerdotes rezaram para que o fogo passasse longe, e algo respondeu com podridão. O Círculo dos Espinhos corta a praga a cada estação. A cada estação ela cresce mais rápido.

Some rifts do not hold a guardian. They hold a herald. The fragments they leave can be pressed into a key, and the key opens a door to the Omen itself: Sangrith of the Bloodmoon, Morvane the Hollow Crown, Thalcyra the Stormbound Seer. Each one foretells the same thing in a different voice.

Algumas fendas não guardam um guardião. Guardam um arauto. Os fragmentos que deixam podem ser prensados em uma chave, e a chave abre a porta para o próprio Presságio: Sangrith da Lua de Sangue, Morvane a Coroa Oca, Thalcyra a Vidente da Tempestade. Cada um prevê a mesma coisa com uma voz diferente.

Sangrith walked out of the red night that followed the first fall, carrying a sickle of moonlight. He harvests what the fire missed. Those who fight him say the floor fills with blood before anyone is cut.

Sangrith saiu da noite vermelha que seguiu a primeira queda, carregando uma foice de luar. Ele colhe o que o fogo deixou para trás. Quem o enfrenta diz que o chão se enche de sangue antes que alguém seja ferido.

Morvane was a queen once, of a kingdom that burned in one night. She kept the crown and lost the head beneath it. Her court of wraiths still bows to the empty throne, and they expect you to bow as well.

Morvane foi rainha um dia, de um reino que queimou em uma única noite. Ela ficou com a coroa e perdeu a cabeça que a usava. Sua corte de espectros ainda se curva ao trono vazio, e espera que você se curve também.

Thalcyra looked into the falling sky to read what came after, and the sky looked back. Now she is the storm she saw. Lightning finds the ground she marks a breath before it falls. Read the marks, or join her vision.

Thalcyra olhou para o céu em queda para ler o que viria depois, e o céu olhou de volta. Agora ela é a tempestade que viu. O raio encontra o chão que ela marca um instante antes de cair. Leia as marcas, ou entre em sua visão.

entries.name: The Ascended Omens and the Ember Gate

p: An Omen that is slain does not stay slain. Bind three shards of its herald into a sigil and it returns, Ascended, behind the Ember Gate. The fallen wait in the antechamber for the Gate to let them back. It always does, until it does not.

Um Presságio abatido não continua abatido. Una três fragmentos do seu arauto em um sigilo e ele retorna, Ascendido, atrás do Portão de Brasa. Os caídos esperam na antecâmara até que o Portão os deixe voltar. Ele sempre deixa, até o dia em que não deixa.

Every Omen sings of one thing: the first Cinder, the one that never cooled. It has a name now, Ysgrath, and a heartbeat you can feel through the soles of your boots. It remembers the red night, the hollow court and the storm, because it made them. Only those who have ended all three may stand before it.

Todo Presságio canta sobre uma só coisa: a primeira Brasa, a que nunca esfriou. Agora ela tem um nome, Ysgrath, e um batimento que se sente pela sola das botas. Ela lembra a noite vermelha, a corte oca e a tempestade, porque foi ela que os criou. Só quem encerrou os três pode ficar diante dela.

The Sepulchre was not built to honour a king. It was built to hold one. Varkhul, the Ashen Sovereign, ruled until the fire made him something that would not die, and his own wardens walled him in with everything that served him. Gravewarden Ulthar still keeps the first gate. Morwen the Ash-Sister still sings. The last door opens from the inside.

O Sepulcro não foi construído para honrar um rei. Foi construído para prendê-lo. Varkhul, o Soberano Cinzento, reinou até que o fogo o transformou em algo que não morre, e seus próprios guardiões o emparedaram com tudo o que o servia. O Guardião de Túmulos Ulthar ainda vigia o primeiro portão. Morwen, a Irmã das Cinzas, ainda canta. A última porta se abre por dentro.

Kaelgor led the first army through a burning rift and found nothing on the other side worth conquering, so he conquers ours, again and again. His banner is a sheet of flame. His soldiers are whoever he killed last time.

Kaelgor liderou o primeiro exército através de uma fenda em chamas e não encontrou do outro lado nada que valesse conquistar; então conquista o nosso, de novo e de novo. Seu estandarte é uma cortina de fogo. Seus soldados são quem ele matou da última vez.

Where a Cinder fell into the northern ice, the ice did not melt. It woke. Skaldra wears the cold like a gown and freezes the sky wherever she descends. She hates the fire more than any of us. That does not make her a friend.

Onde uma Brasa caiu no gelo do norte, o gelo não derreteu. Ele despertou. Skaldra veste o frio como um vestido e congela o céu onde quer que desça. Ela odeia o fogo mais do que qualquer um de nós. Isso não a torna uma aliada.

The plague pits were dug for the dead of the first fall. Something kept feeding on them after the digging stopped, and grew, and gave birth. The Thornbound Circle burns its brood on sight and still cannot find the pit it crawls out of.

As covas da peste foram cavadas para os mortos da primeira queda. Algo continuou se alimentando deles depois que pararam de cavar, e cresceu, e deu à luz. O Círculo dos Espinhos queima sua ninhada assim que a vê e ainda não encontrou a cova de onde ela rasteja.

The Veiled Choir sang to the void for a hundred nights. On the hundred and first, the void sang back, and Nyxareth stepped out of the tear. The Choir calls it a misunderstanding. The Vigil calls it a debt.
O Coro Velado cantou para o vazio por cem noites. Na centésima primeira, o vazio cantou de volta, e Nyxareth saiu do rasgo. O Coro chama isso de mal-entendido. A Vigília chama de dívida.
Vharok is what a battlefield becomes when no one buries the fallen. Every war since the first fall added to him. When the earth trembles, he is counting the new dead.
Vharok é o que um campo de batalha se torna quando ninguém enterra os caídos. Cada guerra desde a primeira queda aumentou seu corpo. Quando a terra treme, ele está contando os novos mortos.

Under every town there is a stair that was not there before the fall. It goes down further each time someone walks it. The rooms change. The heat does not. No one has found the bottom, and those who claim to have found it do not go back.

Sob cada cidade há uma escada que não existia antes da queda. Ela desce mais a cada vez que alguém a percorre. As salas mudam. O calor não. Ninguém encontrou o fundo, e quem diz ter encontrado não volta lá.

Past the reach of any map lie places the fire hollowed out on its own: the Emberdeep Hollows, the Sunken Ossuary, the Cinderfall Wastes, the Hollow Vault. Each has a keeper grown fat on Cinder heat: the Emberdeep Maw, the Ossuary Warden, Cinderwing, and Vault Keeper Ossrim, who still counts coins no one will spend.

Além do alcance de qualquer mapa ficam lugares que o fogo escavou sozinho: Emberdeep Hollows, Sunken Ossuary, Cinderfall Wastes e The Hollow Vault. Cada um tem um guardião engordado pelo calor das Brasas: The Emberdeep Maw, The Ossuary Warden, Cinderwing e Vault Keeper Ossrim, que ainda conta moedas que ninguém vai gastar.

Below the Vault the fire kept digging. The Marrow Crypts, where Ossivane the Gravecage walks on the ribs of a dead giant. The Iron Crucible, whose Forgewarden Kharzun still guards a forge no hand works. The Fallen Sanctum, where Vaelith sings what is left of a hymn. And last the Pyre Throne, where Azhkarrath, mother of the pyrewings, lies chained to the seat she burned. Each door opens to one at a time.

Abaixo do Vault o fogo continuou cavando. The Marrow Crypts, onde Ossivane the Gravecage anda sobre as costelas de um gigante morto. The Iron Crucible, cujo Forgewarden Kharzun ainda guarda uma forja que nenhuma mão trabalha. The Fallen Sanctum, onde Vaelith canta o que restou de um hino. E por último The Pyre Throne, onde Azhkarrath, mãe dos pyrewings, jaz acorrentada ao trono que queimou. Cada porta se abre para um de cada vez.

entries.name: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

p: The ash has always fallen on the broken world. This season it falls heavier and warmer, and Archivist Maelis, the Chronicler, has opened a new book. What the whole realm does together is written in it, and the world answers.

One chapter is open at a time. The whole realm writes it: every world boss slain, rift sealed, Omen and Ascended Omen defeated, Ashen Sepulchre cleared, character reaching a level and world event won counts for the chapter whose goal it is. When every goal is met the chapter is written and the world changes. Adventure > Chronicle shows the bars, your part and the top contributors.

rows: II. The Wound Beside the Walls

p: The Chronicler records the top contributors of every chapter: the client's Record tab and the website's Chronicle page keep them. The next season starts a new book, and the world changes of this one are taken back.
A Crônica das Cinzas: Temporada das Cinzas

As cinzas sempre caíram sobre o mundo partido. Nesta temporada elas caem mais grossas e mais quentes, e a Arquivista Maelis, a Cronista, abriu um livro novo. O que o reino inteiro fizer junto será escrito nele, e o mundo vai responder.

entries.name: I. The Ash Thickens
entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

p: The ash falls warm to the touch now, and in the capital's streets the wind no longer carries it away. Beyond the walls the small rifts open faster than the Vigil's wardens can count them.
The Chronicler has written one line on the first page: "The world remembers what it does." Turn the keys. Seal the small wounds before they learn to grow, and let the new hunters find their strength.
Ash drifts and scorched cracks now mark the ground around the capital's temple.
The capital changes around its temple.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
I. As Cinzas se Adensam
Agora as cinzas caem mornas, e nas ruas da capital o vento já não as leva embora. Além das muralhas, as fendas pequenas se abrem mais rápido do que os guardiões da Vigília conseguem contar.

A Cronista escreveu uma única linha na primeira página: "O mundo se lembra do que faz." Girem as chaves. Selem as feridas pequenas antes que aprendam a crescer, e deixem que os novos caçadores descubram a própria força.
Montes de cinza e rachaduras queimadas agora marcam o chão em volta do templo da capital.

entries.name: II. The Wound Beside the Walls
entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

p: Where the Five last fell, the ground did not close. A seam of cinders runs beside the capital's walls, and Kaelgor, Skaldra, the Rotmother, Nyxareth and Vharok come back through the temple portals angrier each time.
Break them, again and again. Seal the deeper rifts that feed the seam. When it is quiet enough to walk into, the wardens will open the way.
The Cinderscar Breach is open: its gate stands by the capital's temple. Rubble from the Five's last assault lies near the temple.
The Cinderscar Breach opens (level 400 and above): its gate appears in the world.
The capital changes around its temple.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
II. A Ferida ao Lado das Muralhas

Onde os Cinco caíram pela última vez, o chão não se fechou. Um veio de brasas corre ao lado das muralhas da capital, e Kaelgor, Skaldra, a Mãe Podre, Nyxareth e Vharok voltam pelos portais dos templos cada vez mais furiosos.
Derrubem-nos quantas vezes for preciso. Selem as fendas mais fundas que alimentam o veio. Quando ele estiver calmo o bastante para alguém entrar, os guardiões vão abrir o caminho.
A Cinderscar Breach está aberta: o portão fica junto ao templo da capital. Escombros do último ataque dos Cinco estão perto do templo.

entries.name: III. Omens in the Ashfall
entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

p: Sangrith's blood moon has been seen over the rifts, Morvane's hollow crown in the ash clouds, Thalcyra's storm in the deepest tiers. The Omens are no longer waiting behind their keys.
Press the fragments into keys, walk into their arenas and put them down before what they foretell arrives. Light the ward-fires when they fall.
Ward-fires burn around the capital's temple.
The capital changes around its temple.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
III. Presságios na Chuva de Cinzas

A lua de sangue de Sangrith foi vista sobre as fendas, a coroa oca de Morvane nas nuvens de cinza, a tempestade de Thalcyra nos níveis mais profundos. Os Presságios já não esperam atrás das suas chaves.
Prensem os fragmentos em chaves, entrem nas arenas deles e derrubem-nos antes que chegue o que eles anunciam. Acendam as fogueiras de guarda quando eles caírem.
Fogueiras de guarda queimam em volta do templo da capital.

entries.name: IV. The Sepulchre Stirs
entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

p: Beneath the capital, the Ashen Sepulchre breathes. What was walled in with Varkhul no longer sleeps between one raid and the next; at night its bones knock against a sealed stair under the city.
Clear the Sepulchre, face the Ascended forms of the Omens, and the stair the old wardens walled up will be ours to walk.
The Ossuary Stair below the capital is open: its gate stands by the capital's temple.
The Ossuary Stair opens (level 380 and above): its gate appears in the world.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
IV. O Sepulcro Desperta
Embaixo da capital, o Sepulcro Cinzento respira. O que foi emparedado junto com Varkhul já não dorme entre uma incursão e outra; de noite, seus ossos batem contra uma escada selada sob a cidade.
Limpem o Sepulcro, enfrentem as formas Ascendidas dos Presságios, e a escada que os antigos guardiões muraram será nossa para descer.
A Ossuary Stair, embaixo da capital, está aberta: o portão fica junto ao templo da capital.

entries.name: V. Embers Rekindled
entries.sub: The Ashen Chronicle: Season of Ash

p: Ysgrath the Cinderheart is the first Cinder, the one that never cooled, and while it beats the ash will never stop. Bind its sigil from the relics of the Ascended, gather the strong, and hold the towns when the invaders come.
When the Cinderheart falls, carry what is left of its flame back to the Great Brazier. Let the capital remember that it was rebuilt, not spared.
The capital is rebuilt: the ash and rubble are cleared and flowers grow where the cracks were.
The capital changes around its temple.
Earlier scars of the capital are cleared away.
The Chronicler's words move on, the realm hears a broadcast, and the top contributors are recorded at the season's end.
V. Brasas Reacesas

Ysgrath, o Coração de Brasa, é a primeira Brasa, a que nunca esfriou, e enquanto ela pulsar as cinzas não vão parar de cair. Unam o seu sigilo com as relíquias dos Ascendidos, reúnam os fortes e defendam as cidades quando os invasores vierem.
Quando o Coração de Brasa cair, levem o que restar da sua chama de volta ao Grande Braseiro. Que a capital se lembre de que foi reconstruída, e não poupada.
A capital foi reconstruída: as cinzas e os escombros sumiram, e há flores onde ficavam as rachaduras.

A plaza in the capital keeps the season: guardian statues for its realm firsts, statues for its records and memorial stones for the heroes who fell in Hardcore. Look at one to read it. A stone in the middle says what is remembered; when there are more names than statues, they turn every 10 minutes.

Every name is there by its player's choice (Adventure > Chronicle > Memorial): records and realm firsts are shown unless you turn them off, a Hardcore fall only after your yes, asked at the next login after the fall. You can change it any time. Each season starts a new Memorial; the website keeps the past ones.

Uma praça na capital guarda a temporada: estátuas de guardião para as primeiras vitórias do reino, estátuas para os recordes e pedras memoriais para os heróis que caíram no Hardcore. Cada nome está lá por escolha do jogador: recordes e primeiras vitórias aparecem, a menos que você desligue; uma queda no Hardcore só depois do seu sim. Você pode mudar quando quiser.
